outcome.technical:
WHAT CHANGED. _affected_tests.py gains a fifth arm, `walk` (ARMS = related, python, walk, e2e-changed, e2e-widening). When a task edits a suite, select() reads statically, from the parsed sources, which directories every runner's cases walk, and selects each runner whose walk covers the edited suite. Runners are the Python tests named as tests, plus every .py the recorded all-runners listing (meta.phaseGate.derived.listing.all; this repo records `tools/affected.py --list-all`) names, so a lint carrying its own cases (tools/_suite.py) counts. The walk primitives are os.walk/listdir/scandir, glob.glob/iglob and Path rglob/iterdir, plus every project function that calls one, resolved through import aliases, from-imports and same-module defs. Path values are evaluated from literals, __file__, os.path.join/dirname, Path, `/`, `+`, conditionals, module constants (including other modules'), a `.replace('/', os.sep)` separator swap, tuple-unpacking loops over a constant table, and joins of parameters filled at the call site. The project root counts only when anchored on __file__. A recorded listing that cannot answer widens to the phase gate and says so; it never silently drops a walker. New gate_runs() lists what a task's gate entries actually run, so the program a path-scoped call names (the sweep runner in `python3 tools/sweep.py tests/x.py`) is not counted as run. New steps_for() settles the test-support widening: when the support paths changed and the task's gate carries a declared entry whose command is the selection's own spelling with the paths taken out (the word comparison left_to_run makes), no phase-gate step is added and the line names that key. A narrow path-scoped gate still widens. entries_for/left_to_run were refactored onto shared _spelling/_spell/_declared_calls/_unscoped_entry helpers, with behaviour unchanged (test_run_test_gate 581 cases green). run-test-gate.py: _affected_facts runs the all-runners listing and reads pySources when a suite was edited, and affected_steps uses gate_runs and steps_for. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: the arm list in the tree line and the section now match ARMS, a false claim that coupling was an arm was removed, and two paragraphs were added (the walk arm with what it cannot see, and the steps_for settling). Not edited: _gate_derive.py, test_derive_phase_gate.py, test__gate_derive.py and tools/check-example-ledgers.py. The phase-level derivation does not add walkers; its facts come from derive-phase-gate.py, which this task does not own, and this repo's phase gate is the unscoped sweep, which runs every runner.

CASES. test__affected_tests (45 cases): af30 (exactly the three fixture walkers, including the param-route and surfaces-table shapes, and the unanchored root refused), af31 (a spec outside tests/ selects only the root walker, and app source selects none), af32 (a failed all-listing widens, naming `exited 3` and walk), af33 (gate [selftests] with only tests/_harness.py: no steps, no widen, the line names selftests), af34 (three narrow gates still widen), af35 (support plus a python-selected suite settle together), af36 (dogfood: editing tests/test_stamp_verification.py in this repo selects tools/_suite.py under walk; the reference lint is selected and its walk holds both `tests` and `tools`, the latter reachable only through its surfaces table; tests/test__worktrees.py is not a walker), af37 (gate_runs drops the program of a path-scoped call). test_run_test_gate: as6 (end to end, gate selftests and the harness edit add only selftests), as7 (a narrow own gate still gets both phase-gate entries), as8 (an edited suite with a recorded listing runs the sweep runner under affected/walk).

Mutation probe: 13 mutations over both directions (arm adds nothing, every runner covers everything, parameters not followed, unanchored root counts, failed listing not widening, support never settled, support settled by any entry, support paths hidden, listing never run, program counted as run, separator swap, unpack loop, parameter joins dropped). M12 (the unpack binding) changes no root in this repo, measured by a separate diagnostic, and is held by af30 alone. ruff and vermin are clean on the four Python files.

outcome.descriptive: A task that edits a suite now also runs every runner whose tree walk covers that suite, read statically from the runners' own code, and a test-support change no longer widens to the phase gate when the task's gate already runs the unscoped sweep.
